name: unifinv
expr: x_d = unifinv(0.5); x_d0 = unifinv(0); x_d1 = unifinv(1); x_dlo = unifinv(-0.1); x_dhi = unifinv(1.5); x_s = unifinv(0.5, 0, 1); x_w = unifinv(0.25, 1, 5); x_lo = unifinv(0, 1, 5); x_hi = unifinv(1, 1, 5); x_v = unifinv(ps, 0, 10); x_b0 = unifinv(0.5, 1, 0); x_brev = unifinv(0.5, 5, 1); x_eq = unifinv(0.5, 1, 1); x_nan = unifinv(NaN, 0, 1);
comment: Sig: x = unifinv(p[, a, b]). Inverse Continuous Uniform CDF on [a, b]: x = a + p*(b-a). Defaults a=0, b=1. p=0 -> a; p=1 -> b; p outside [0,1] -> NaN; b<=a -> NaN; NaN p -> NaN.
